text: The instructor uses examples that connect theory and practice.
The instructor encourages questions and participation.
The pace of classes is appropriate.
Assessments are aligned with what was taught.
Assessment criteria are made clear in advance.
Feedback on assessments is timely and useful.
Classrooms are adequate for the activities proposed.
Laboratories and practice settings are well equipped.
The library offers the resources I need.
Internet access on campus is reliable.
I know where to seek academic support when I need it.
Administrative services answer my requests promptly.
The institution listens to student feedback.
